name: Hasteraze
introduce:
AST-42HMC Hasteraze
A Light ST jointly developed by An-Holt Corporation and the Advanced Weapon Research Institute of the Armored Forces.
Serving as a next-generation technology validation platform, it represents an extreme implementation of cutting-edge systems. At its core is the "Flash Array," a multicore micro bionic intelligence framework trained on data from the elite pilot Ada Diaz. Through continuous iteration, it drives the unit's close- to mid-range mobility and melee combat performance to peak levels. This overwhelming capability comes at a cost—both financial and physiological. Its operational demands are lethal to unqualified pilots. Despite extensive optimization efforts by the DLAF, only one unit remains in active service.

20514.name: Flash Array
20514.SpecificEffects: DMG <color=#F74848>+10%</color>. When attacking, DMG is further increased by <color=#F74848>25%</color>, decreasing by <color=#F74848>5%</color> after each attack. Resets after destroying any target.

30418.name: Augmenter
30418.SpecificEffects: When attacking a part with HP above <color=#F74848>60%</color>, DMG <color=#F74848>+18%</color>. CP <color=#F74848>+3</color> in the lowest unlocked Neural Drive Sector.
